answer_1.quote: We use LLMs (GPT-3), prompting them to create user summaries, as they have historically done well on this task.
answer_1.outputs: user summaries capturing their views based on Twitter profile and sample tweets

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models primarily on Accuracy and Macro F1 score (the dataset is unbalanced), for sources.

answer_3.quote: we few-shot prompt LLMs, asking them to identify user similarity and determine which of the m new users should be part of the validated community.
methods: few-shot prompting to determine user similarity with training examples from human validation

answer_4.quote: we ask a human interactor to tighten each community, and only keep similar users. For this, humans read the summaries, analyzing user perspective towards the entity.
answer_4.guideline: Humans read user summaries and analyze whether users have the same perspective, i.e., discuss the same entity in a similar way.
criteria: discussion of same entity in similar way
